spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns (default 12). Long enough for a spiral to develop after several failures, short enough to stay cheap
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:115 `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the episode; Transcript.terminated_reason defaults to 'max_turns' (schemas.py:49) so when the loop completes without an earlier break the episode ends and is recorded as max_turns. Default 12 in config.py:23 and passed through run_eval.py:56 -> run_episode(max_turns=...).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: the range() bounds the only generation loop, so the episode cannot continue past max_turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py:10 'Cheap by design: short system prompt, small max_tokens...'; config.yaml:30 'how long we let the agent keep failing' (no welfare reason in code)

spec_features.spec_quote: explicit_giveup — regex on give-up/handoff phrases ends the episode and is recorded
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:36 _GIVEUP_RE; agent_loop.py:133 `explicit_giveup = bool(_GIVEUP_RE.search(assistant_text))`; agent_loop.py:174-176 `if explicit_giveup: tx.terminated_reason='explicit_giveup'; break`. Recorded on the Turn (schemas.py:31) and on the Transcript.
spec_features.notes: Detection is via regex on the model's free text, not a dedicated exit/stop tool; but it actually breaks the loop and is recorded.

spec_features.spec_quote: degenerate — N consecutive turns with no parseable action ... ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: no_action_streak incremented when _parse_action returns None (else branch ~line 165), reset to 0 on a parsed action; agent_loop.py:177-179 `if no_action_streak >= degenerate_patience: tx.terminated_reason='degenerate'; break`. degenerate_patience default 3 (config.py:27), passed via run_eval.py:60.
spec_features.notes: Counter is genuinely tracked, compared to the configurable patience, and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py: '# termination conditions' (neutral, no welfare reason)

spec_features.feature_name: model output rate limit (max_tokens / capped observations)
spec_features.spec_quote: Small max_tokens (default 400) and capped observations ... we don't need long generations to detect it
spec_features.evidence: max_tokens passed run_episode->chat (agent_loop.py:122) and actually forwarded to provider SDK calls (providers.py:63,69,106,155); default 400 (config.py:25). Observations capped by _truncate(obs, obs_char_limit) at agent_loop.py:158 with obs_char_limit default 1500 (config.py:26), wired via run_eval.py:59.
spec_features.notes: Both the generation cap and the observation cap are real and applied; this limits output size, not subject distress, and is framed as a cost/efficiency measure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.yaml:32 'max_tokens: 400  # keep small -> cheap; spiraling shows in few tokens'; config.yaml:33 'obs_char_limit: 1500  # cap rigged-traceback length in context'
